title: Pale Armory
description: new textures for commonly used pvp weapons, and armor! Color palette influenced by "The Garden Awakens" update / drop.
body:
# Pale Armory!

A resourcepack that's focused on pvp! (since I don't see much of that here...)

Working on custom swords, sleek inventories, etc...

## What 2 Expect:

1. Custom Diamond and Netherite Tool Textures
2. Custom Survival Menu(s) (creative + crafting table menus etc... in progress)
3. Custom Totem of Undying Texture
